## Working model
```{r}
raw_data <- read.csv("scraped_database_10_25.csv", row.names = NULL)

clean_df <- raw_data |>
  select(-"Solution..breif.description.", 
         -"Filter.material", 
         -"Mean.flow.resistance..m.kg.")

names(clean_df) <- c("Solution", 
                     "Filter_material", 
                     "Filter_loading",
                     "Pore_size",
                     "Effective_Area", 
                     "Duration",
                     "Volume",
                     "Pressure_drop",
                     "Max_Flux",
                     "Volumetric_Flux",
                     "Permiability",
                     "Starting_Flux",
                     "Flow_Rate",
                     "Concentration",
                     "Source")

#converting columns to numeric
i <- c(3:14)
clean_df[, i] <- apply(clean_df[, i], 2, function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x)))
                 
sapply(clean_df, class)

#encoding pore size
pore_sizes <- c(0.014, 0.040, 0.100, 0.200, 0.220, 0.300, 0.400, 0.450)
clean_df$pore_size_encoded <- as.integer(factor(clean_df$Pore_size, levels = pore_sizes, ordered = TRUE))

#dataset with na dropped
no_na <- clean_df |>
  drop_na() |>
  select(-Pore_size)
no_na[3:13, 15] <- scale(no_na[3:13, 15], center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)

#working dataset
dummy <- dummyVars(" ~ .", data=select(no_na, -Source))
working_df <- data.frame(predict(dummy, newdata=select(no_na, -Source)))
working_df$Source <- no_na$Source

#working model
working_model <- lm(Filter_loading~
           Effective_Area + 
           Duration +
           Volume + 
           Pressure_drop +
           Permiability + 
           Flow_Rate, 
         no_na)
```
## Feature selection

```{r}
# preform feature selection for multiple linear regression, Gamma GLM, Gaussian GLM
# Making Test/Training sets
set.seed(123)
trainIndex <- createDataPartition(working_df$Filter_loading, p = 0.7, list = FALSE)

train <- working_df[trainIndex, ]
test  <- working_df[-trainIndex, ]

x_train <- train[, !(names(train) %in% c("Filter_loading", "Source", "Volumetric_Flux"))]
y_train <- train$Filter_loading

x_test  <- test[, !(names(test) %in% c("Filter_loading", "Source", "Volumetric_Flux"))]
y_test  <- test$Filter_loading  # Fixed y_train -> y_test typo

nzv <- nearZeroVar(x_train)
if (length(nzv) > 0) {
  x_train <- x_train[, -nzv]
  x_test  <- x_test[, -nzv]
}

# B. Remove Exact Linear Combinations / Dependencies
lin_combos <- findLinearCombos(x_train)
if (!is.null(lin_combos$remove)) {
  x_train <- x_train[, -lin_combos$remove]
  x_test  <- x_test[, -lin_combos$remove]
}

# C. Remove Highly Correlated Predictors (|r| > 0.85)
high_corr <- findCorrelation(cor(x_train, use = "pairwise.complete.obs"), cutoff = 0.85)
if (length(high_corr) > 0) {
  x_train <- x_train[, -high_corr]
  x_test  <- x_test[, -high_corr]
}


get_glm_rfe_funcs <- function(fam) {
  funcs <- lmFuncs
  
  # Fit GLM with specified family
  funcs$fit <- function(x, y, first, last, ...) {
    dat <- as.data.frame(x)
    dat$y <- y
    glm(y ~ ., data = dat, family = fam, ...)
  }
  
  # Predict on response scale
  funcs$pred <- function(object, x) {
    predict(object, newdata = as.data.frame(x), type = "response")
  }
  
  # Rank variables by absolute z-statistic or t-statistic magnitude
  funcs$rank <- function(object, x, y) {
    coef_mat <- summary(object)$coefficients
    coef_mat <- coef_mat[rownames(coef_mat) != "(Intercept)", , drop = FALSE]
    
    stat_col <- grep("(z|t) value", colnames(coef_mat), value = TRUE)[1]
    importance <- abs(coef_mat[, stat_col])
    
    vimp <- data.frame(
      Overall = importance,
      var = names(importance)
    )
    vimp[order(vimp$Overall, decreasing = TRUE), ]
  }
  
  return(funcs)
}

subsets <- 1:ncol(x_train)

# ----------------------------------------------------
# Model 1: Multiple Linear Regression (OLS)
# ----------------------------------------------------
ctrl_lm <- rfeControl(functions = lmFuncs, method = "cv", number = 10)

rfe_lm <- rfe(
  x = x_train,
  y = y_train,
  sizes = subsets,
  rfeControl = ctrl_lm,
  metric = "Rsquared"
)

# ----------------------------------------------------
# Model 2: Gaussian GLM (Identity Link)
# ----------------------------------------------------
ctrl_gaussian <- rfeControl(
  functions = get_glm_rfe_funcs(gaussian(link = "identity")),
  method = "cv",
  number = 10
)

rfe_gaussian <- rfe(
  x = x_train,
  y = y_train,
  sizes = subsets,
  rfeControl = ctrl_gaussian,
  metric = "Rsquared"
)

# ----------------------------------------------------
# Model 3: Gamma GLM (Log Link - Requires y > 0)
# ----------------------------------------------------
ctrl_gamma <- rfeControl(
  functions = get_glm_rfe_funcs(Gamma(link = "log")),
  method = "cv",
  number = 10
)

rfe_gamma <- rfe(
  x = x_train,
  y = y_train,
  sizes = subsets,
  rfeControl = ctrl_gamma,
  metric = "Rsquared"
)

# ----------------------------------------------------
# Extract Predictors & Evaluate on Test Set
# ----------------------------------------------------
cat("Selected Features (LM):", predictors(rfe_lm), "\n")
cat("Selected Features (Gaussian GLM):", predictors(rfe_gaussian), "\n")
cat("Selected Features (Gamma GLM):", predictors(rfe_gamma), "\n")

# Evaluation function returning test set R-squared
eval_metrics <- function(rfe_model, x_test, y_test) {
  preds <- predict(rfe_model, x_test)
  
  # Handle prediction output structure safely
  if (is.list(preds) || is.data.frame(preds)) {
    if ("pred" %in% names(preds)) preds <- preds$pred
  }
  
  # Calculate R-squared (squared Pearson correlation, matching caret default)
  r_squared <- cor(preds, y_test, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")^2
  
  return(c(R2 = r_squared))
}

test_comparison <- data.frame(
  LM           = eval_metrics(rfe_lm, x_test, y_test),
  Gaussian_GLM = eval_metrics(rfe_gaussian, x_test, y_test),
  Gamma_GLM    = eval_metrics(rfe_gamma, x_test, y_test)
)

print(test_comparison)
```
